# SB-1036 Safety bulletin: hot metal and scale ejection

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01

## Hazard description
Hot metal and scale ejection from the radial ring rolling process can project molten or incandescent material beyond intended containment during upset rolls, part breakouts, or scale slough. Ejected material poses a burn and impact hazard to operators, maintenance personnel, and nearby equipment. Secondary ignition of combustible materials and damage to control enclosures are credible consequences. This bulletin consolidates observed failure modes and prescribes mandatory controls to reduce exposure during operation and maintenance.

## Affected equipment
- Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) located on line P2-L3, Plant P2.  
- Auxiliary handling fixtures and in-process containment immediately adjacent to EQ-P2-L3-RR01.  
- Personnel performing setup, roll change, and edge-trimming tasks at EQ-P2-L3-RR01.

The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 165 hours.

## Required controls
- Establish local shielding and deflection plates that prevent line-of-fire exposure during routine production and foreseeable upset conditions. Inspect shielding integrity before shift turnover.  
- Enforce mandatory use of heat- and scale-resistant PPE for all personnel within the hazard zone during operations and maintenance.  
- Coordinate lockout/tagout and energy control actions per SOP-P2-L3-01 before any inbound access to roll nip, housing, or downstream trimming stations.  
- During planned maintenance, follow the machine lubrication and access sequence in MM-P2-L3-RR01 and verify lubrication records against the specified lubrication interval for bearings.  
- Prohibit personnel from standing in the direct line-of-fire during roll engagement and part breakthrough events. Implement remote monitoring and camera verification where feasible.  
- Report any uncontained ejection event immediately and initiate the post-event inspection checklist referenced in SOP-P2-L3-04.

## Effective date
Effective immediately upon issuance of this bulletin. Review and compliance are mandatory until superseded by subsequent revision.
